env.name: RPC_URL
env.description: Ethereum RPC endpoint URL (e.g., Infura, Alchemy, https://eth.llamarpc.com)

env.name: PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Wallet private key for signing transactions (with or without 0x prefix)

env.name: ETHERSCAN_API_KEY
env.description: Etherscan API key for fetching verified contract ABIs

dockerfile:
FROM python:3.12-slim@sha256:a6e34c598f2467ed0e9a8d349809fcd8b5c603269512df273a0bb1784edc11b1
ENV OPENSSL_armcap=0x1fff
ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir --root-user-action=ignore --disable-pip-version-check abi-to-mcp==0.1.0
USER 65534:65534
